passages.locator: Exhibit 99.13, slides 38–39, isolated contact hole and proof of concept
passages.note: Slide 38 reports a 1.2 µm depth of focus for a 130 nm isolated contact hole on the AT:1150i, more than twice the dry AT:1150 comparison in that trial. Slide 39 identifies the converted 1150 lens and the AT platform adapted for liquid handling at full scan speed.
The associated ASML release explains how the existing dual-stage design allowed a liquid exposure station and an air-based measurement station, retaining familiar focus and overlay measurement.
